bounded_question: Can the real COMP shell carry empty, loading/transitional, unavailable, failed/cancelled and provisional/non-effective workspace states while preserving application truth, fictional boundaries and exact task return without freezing Product-gated lifecycle/provider mechanics?

fixed_inputs.state: STA-01 F2 where authoritative interaction state requires it

must_preserve: empty / no active Scene is valid Production state; empty != error or deletion
loading / transitional is application state; loading != fictional delay or performed waiting
capability unavailable is technical state; unavailable != Character refusal, silence, incapacity or hesitation
failed / cancelled technical attempt creates no accepted Production mutation, consequence or causal history
provisional / non-effective remains structurally distinct from current / effective
one shell survives all five state families without information-architecture redesign
prior semantic origin and focus-return target remain recoverable when still valid
Back / Close is navigation, not Undo
hard_falsifiers: Any empty-state surface implies deletion, corruption or fictional absence.
Any loading/transitional surface implies fictional time passage or Character waiting/hesitation.
Any unavailable surface translates infrastructure limitation into Character refusal or incapacity.
Any failed/cancelled surface implies accepted Production change or narrative consequence.
Any provisional surface can be mistaken for current/effective without reading color/theme.
Any Product-dependent lifecycle/provider/retry/fallback command is introduced as an app control.
Theme or accent encodes loading, failure, availability, effectiveness, success or severity.
state_hook_rule: The deterministic carrier may expose a test-only JavaScript state hook to exercise the five accepted state families; this hook is evidence instrumentation and not Product UI or runtime authority.
non_authority: No Create/Start/Resume Scene, Take, branch, rehearsal, retry, fallback or provider command is created.
No loading duration, progress algorithm, cancellation, retry, recovery, provider/model/cost or failure policy is frozen.
No final Scene lifecycle, consequence, timer/transcript/Pause, production token, native implementation or Stage successor authority is created.
Fixture state labels are design-evidence witnesses rather than final shipping copy.
next: Materialize the five accepted state families inside the real COMP shell, run the seven-case matrix, recursively audit application-truth versus fiction boundaries, then preserve only if clean.
